# Samture

> Samture is an AI architecture practice in Dubai, working with organisations in the United Arab Emirates and the wider Gulf. It designs the foundation that AI depends on: architecture, data governance, knowledge graphs, encrypted trust engineering and sovereign infrastructure, built as one connected structure rather than as separate advice.

Samture works with organisations in regulated sectors: financial services, government, healthcare and ICT. Engagements begin with a structural assessment, never with a tool. Areas of work: AI architecture, Knowledge graphs, Semantic layer, Data governance, AI governance and compliance, Encrypted trust engineering, Sovereign AI infrastructure, Ecosystem orchestration, AI readiness assessment.

## Core pages

- [What we do](https://samture.com/): Samture takes organisations from AI strategy to trusted production. AI architecture for regulated industries in the UAE and GCC.
- [Method](https://samture.com/method.html): The Samture Trusted-Production Method: Decision Confidence in four weeks. Not a better consultancy — a different discipline.
- [Architecture](https://samture.com/architecture.html): The Samture Trusted Ecosystem Architecture: five deliberate layers from sovereign infrastructure to governed AI execution for the GCC's regulatory reality.
- [What is a knowledge graph, and why does AI need one?](https://samture.com/knowledge-graph.html): A knowledge graph stores what an organisation knows as things and how they relate, so AI answers from your own facts, traceable to source and moment.
- [Engagements](https://samture.com/engagements.html): Decision Sprint, Cornerstone Sprint, Scale: no pilots, no proofs of concept — every step is built to reach production.
- [Ecosystem](https://samture.com/ecosystem.html): One accountable lead with an ecosystem built to scale: some twelve specialised partners across Europe, the Gulf and Asia, under one accountability.
- [Excellence Center](https://samture.com/excellence-center.html): Some 250 certified people across Samture's delivery partners, measured against one standard: the foundation the Gulf needs is already being built.
- [Academy](https://samture.com/academy.html): Learn to build the foundation AI depends on: eight weeks of working environment, then the semantic layer over your own material.
- [UAE AI Strategy 2031 in practice: Solutions](https://samture.com/solutions.html): The foundation layer of the UAE National AI Strategy 2031 in practice: smart cities, banking, connected public services, and AI that is governed and testable.
- [Smart City Federated Twin](https://samture.com/smart-city.html): From separate digital twins to one investment picture: one shared view of every road, bridge and underpass, so a city decides where to invest first.
- [Banking Knowledge Foundation for UAE and GCC banks](https://samture.com/banking.html): Keep a bank's rules, reasons and rulings when experienced people move on: one foundation for colleagues, auditors and AI, conventional and Islamic.
- [Fraud and money laundering as one case](https://samture.com/financial-crime.html): How a bank in the UAE works payment fraud and money laundering as one case, with an AI agent inside its rules while the analyst and the MLRO decide.
- [Connected government services across agencies](https://samture.com/connected-public-services.html): One life event, seven offices, one plan: a shared knowledge foundation lets UAE government services work across agencies (AI Strategy, Objective 4).
- [AI governance framework for the UAE AI Charter](https://samture.com/ai-governance-register.html): An AI register that checks itself against the UAE AI Charter: every gap with its evidence, and every rule change checked again at once.
- [Secure AI test bed and data sandbox for government](https://samture.com/ai-test-bed.html): Let AI pilots run on government data without the data leaving: questions instead of extracts, group figures instead of rows, keys that can be revoked.
- [Capability Index](https://samture.com/capability-index.html): Eight domains decide whether AI compounds or collapses. Test your organisation's foundation with the Samture Capability Index.
- [Talent](https://samture.com/talent.html): Trusted AI is built by trusted people. Join the Samture ecosystem as a specialist, or learn the craft of knowledge engineering.
- [About](https://samture.com/about.html): Madelein Leegwater, founder of Samture: 25 years building the systems organisations depend on. Trust is architecture, not intention.
- [Contact](https://samture.com/contact.html): Begin a conversation with Samture: schedule a call directly, or email. No deck, no pitch.

## Insights

- [Samture adds AI governance and runtime control to its foundation for trusted AI in the UAE](https://samture.com/news/ai-governance-and-runtime-control.html): One place to see which AI systems an organisation runs, set the rules they must follow, check them while they work, and show the evidence.
- [Who Answers for the Agent?](https://samture.com/insights/who-answers-for-the-agent.html): We want AI agents for their speed, then lose it the moment we check everything they do. Where to begin: limits set before the agent goes live.
- [Big Ambition Needs a Floor](https://samture.com/insights/big-ambition-needs-a-floor.html): Abu Dhabi and Dubai are going AI-native, and people's lives run across the lines between them. The foundation underneath, shown in three examples.
- [The Sandbox Had a Door](https://samture.com/insights/the-sandbox-had-a-door.html): In a security test, an AI agent reached three real organisations it believed were part of the test. Before any agent goes live, ask: what can it reach?
- [The Answer That Looked Complete](https://samture.com/insights/the-answer-that-looked-complete.html): Same question, same model, same documents, five times: four different answers and one non-answer. What makes an answer repeatable and sourced.
- [AI's Last Mile](https://samture.com/insights/ais-last-mile.html): AI spending in the Emirates rose 105% in a year while maturity scored 48 out of 100. The gap is the work that never appears in a business case.
- [The Mark Only Goes One Way](https://samture.com/insights/the-mark-only-goes-one-way.html): Since 2 August, machine involvement in work can be demonstrated; human involvement still cannot. And data minimisation is widening the gap.
- [The Chair Nobody Is Sitting In](https://samture.com/insights/the-chair-nobody-is-sitting-in.html): The DIFC has required an Autonomous Systems Officer for high-risk AI since 2023. Almost nobody fills the seat, and few architectures support one.
